main_text.p: emptam non esse. Argum. dd.ll. & l.5.D. Aquil.Ordin.Camer. Jud. Imper.part.3.tit.43.n.3. Præ-sertim cum impune offendi nequeant. Bartol.in l. 3.D just. & jur.Clar.5.sent.§.Homicidium. n.52.

Neque distinguendum censeo, inter bannitos qui ex cau-sâ morte digna, & eos, qui ex causâ levi damnati sunt: quasi illis adempta sit salutis defen-sio, hisce non item. In nullâ quippe lege hæc fundata est di-stinctio; etiam prædictarum legum obstat universalitas. Præterquam quòd offensa ta-lium non sit impunita, nisi statutis expressè ita sit cautum. Menoch. Arbitrar.jud.l. 1.quæst.89. fere per totum. Clar.d.§. Homicidium.n.52. Befold.loc.antea citat.
Verùm quid statuendum de talibus Bannitis, qui ob vi-ola-

page.notes: The last word of the page is printed as "vi-" at the end of the full line and "ola-" on the line below at the right; I have treated it as the hyphenated continuation of the paragraph, not as a catchword, so the paragraph ends with "vi-ola-". The page numbers "XIV." and "XV." are bare numbers and are set as paragraphs. Small watermark or digitiser marks at the lower right and the edge of the scan are not transcribed.
